dedupe_keys.name: sptrans developer data gtfs and olho vivo real time bus api sao paulo

description: SPTrans, the company that manages municipal buses in São Paulo, runs a developer area that provides the city's public transport data. It offers the SPTrans GTFS feed of static routes and timetables and the Olho Vivo API, which gives real-time information from the monitoring of the São Paulo bus fleet. Developers register an account to configure applications and obtain an access key. Coverage: São Paulo municipal buses. Format and access: GTFS download and a REST API with a key. Licence and cost: free under SPTrans terms. Caveats: the page is in Portuguese and gives no archive of past positions. It supports network flow and capacity planning of the bus network. It relates to the São Paulo on-demand feeder case study and the GTFS specification in the catalogue.
